name: Cat–camel
movement: on all fours, the back rounded up with the head tucked and let down with the head lifted, slowly, as motion not stretch

phone.placement: Lay the phone on its side on the floor, two or three metres away, side on to you.

words.hint: On all fours, the back rounded up with the chin tucked, then let down with the head lifted, slowly.
words.start: Lay the phone on its side on the floor. Kneel on all fours side on to it, hands under the shoulders, knees under the hips.
words.position: Kneel on all fours side on to the phone, hands under the shoulders, knees under the hips, back in a comfortable middle.
words.top: The back rounded up toward the ceiling with the chin tucked and the head hanging — the cat — then let down into a gentle dip with the head lifted — the camel — without pushing either end.
howto: On all fours, hands under shoulders, knees under hips, arms straight.
Breathe out and round the back up toward the ceiling, tucking the chin and letting the head hang. Easy — no pushing at the end.
Breathe in and let the back dip down, lifting the head gently.
Keep cycling slowly. It is a motion exercise, not a stretch: five to eight cycles are enough.
words.cannot: The curve of the spine itself: it reads the head dropping and lifting with the shoulders, the arms and the hips staying over the knees. Move the whole spine, not just the neck.
words.about: Cat–camel — on all fours side on: the round, as the shoulder-to-ear line off level read against where it was at the start, −45 to −15° at the cat (the head tucked and hanging); a cycle is under way once the head has dropped 10 past the start and counts when it is back within 4; the arms straight, the elbow at least 160°; and the hips over the knees, the knee-to-hip line 75–105° from the floor — rocking back onto the heels is a different stretch. No hold: this is motion, the gentlest thing a sore back can do.
words.lost: Kneel on all fours side on to the camera, the whole body in
words.lower: And let it down — head up
words.early: Round up a little further next time
words.safety: Gentle and slow, inside the pain-free range. No pushing at either end.
words.harder: Nothing — it is a warm-up. Move on to the bird dog.
words.mistakes: Pushing hard into the end of either curve; moving only the neck; rocking back onto the heels; rushing.

measurements.label: head dropped from the start
measurements.why: The shoulder-to-ear line off level, as the change from the start: the head tucking and hanging as the back rounds reads negative, lifting with the dip positive. Also the progress measurement, read downward.

measurements.why: The knee-to-hip line from the floor: 90 with the hips over the knees; rocking back toward the heels lays it down.
